description: This file is a script for analyzing TypeScript source files to detect architecture smells, such as problematic module dependencies, direct references, and module boundary violations, within a codebase as part of a static analysis tool.

methods.name: compareEntries
methods.description: Compares two entries based on category, file, line, kind, specifier, and reason to sort entries.

methods.name: pushEntry
methods.description: Pushes an entry object into the entries array.

methods.name: scanPluginSdkExtensionFacadeSmells
methods.description: Scans a source file for extension facade re-export issues related to plugin SDK public surface.

methods.name: scanRuntimeTypeImplementationSmells
methods.description: Detects direct references in runtime type implementation files that may indicate architectural smells.

methods.name: scanRuntimeServiceLocatorSmells
methods.description: Identifies issues with runtime service locator patterns, such as improper module-global state or accessor pairs.

methods.name: collectArchitectureSmells
methods.description: Collects and returns a list of architecture smells across the codebase's TypeScript files.

methods.name: formatInventoryHuman
methods.description: Formats the detected architecture smells into a human-readable string.

methods.name: runArchitectureSmellsCheck
methods.description: Runs the architecture smell detection and outputs results in JSON or human-readable format.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for executing the script.
